title: The Dual Wing Dark Course
summary: A school course in dark spread like two wings that beat in turn and close together in the final stroke of the school.

title: Manual of the Azure Court Dark
summary: A school manual of court-style dark cuts and rebukes that holds the stance and ends in the sealing judgement of the court.

title: The Twin River Dark Canon
summary: A school canon of two streams of dark qi that run apart in guard and strike and meet at one point in the closing stroke.

title: Canon of the Hawk Court Eclipse
summary: A school canon in which the formed core is made the heart of an eclipse that the hawk of the court lowers on a foe.

title: The Wind-Sworn Dim Course
summary: A school course in dimming the light on the wind and in sworn strokes that follow a fixed bearing to the end.

title: Manual of the Oathbound Pall
summary: A school manual of the pall held under oath that thickens round a foe and ends in a stroke that cannot be called back.

title: The Bearing Canon of the Unwalled Black
summary: A school canon of a black thrown open on a clear bearing that spares no cover and closes in one plain stroke.

title: Canon of the Sworn Extinction
summary: A school canon in which the formed core is used to put out the last light in a field of battle under the school's oath.
